Good post on the dynamics of AI pricing right now. We’re basically going to see a barbell dynamic on pricing between high cost frontier models and cheap but good open or closed weights models.

Then the question is how do you maximize efficiency from the frontier models, and get better quality and performance of the cheaper models. That’s where the applied AI layer comes in.

The applied layer can route to the best model at any time given the workload at hand, as well as mitigate either high token costs or worse performance. The closer you are to the underlying workflow, the better you can tune the use of models for a given business process.

That’s all about understanding the workflows, domain specific FDEs, evals by customer or process, getting data setup well for agents, and more. Overall good for applied AI.

industry_views.social_original_text:
Good post on the dynamics of AI pricing right now. We’re basically going to see a barbell dynamic on pricing between high cost frontier models and cheap but good open or closed weights models.

Then the question is how do you maximize efficiency from the frontier models, and get better quality and performance of the cheaper models. That’s where the applied AI layer comes in.

The applied layer can route to the best model at any time given the workload at hand, as well as mitigate either high token costs or worse performance. The closer you are to the underlying workflow, the better you can tune the use of models for a given business process.

That’s all about understanding the workflows, domain specific FDEs, evals by customer or process, getting data setup well for agents, and more. Overall good for applied AI.

items.title: Are We Ready For An Agent-Native Memory System?
items.title_zh: Are We Ready For An Agent-Native Memory System?
items.takeaway_zh: 从数据管理视角系统研究LLM Agent记忆，提出四模块分析框架，评估12个记忆系统，发现无单一架构占优。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了记忆系统架构与工作负载瓶颈的对齐重要性，为构建真正Agent原生记忆系统指明方向。

items.title: DomainShuttle: Freeform Open Domain Subject-driven Text-to-video Generation
items.title_zh: DomainShuttle: Freeform Open Domain Subject-driven Text-to-video Generation
items.takeaway_zh: 提出DomainShuttle方法，通过Domain-MoT和Video-Reference DualRoPE实现开放域主体驱动视频生成的高保真与灵活编辑。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 解决了现有方法在跨域场景下编辑性不足的问题，提升了视频个性化生成的通用性和适应性。

items.title: Beyond NL2Code: A Structured Survey of Multimodal Code Intelligence
items.title_zh: Beyond NL2Code: 多模态代码智能结构化综述
items.takeaway_zh: 系统综述多模态代码智能，涵盖从视觉输入生成、编辑、推理代码的方法与基准。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为多模态代码生成提供分类框架和评估方向，推动代码智能从文本走向视觉与交互验证。

items.title: Wan-Streamer v0.1: End-to-end Real-time Interactive Foundation Models
items.title_zh: Wan-Streamer v0.1: 端到端实时交互基础模型
items.takeaway_zh: 提出原生流式端到端交互模型，统一建模语言、音频、视频输入输出，实现亚秒级全双工交互。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 减少级联系统延迟与错误累积，为实时音视频交互提供统一基础模型方案。

items.title: IV-CoT: Implicit Visual Chain-of-Thought for Structure-Aware Text-to-Image Generation
items.title_zh: IV-CoT: 隐式视觉思维链用于结构感知文本到图像生成
items.takeaway_zh: 提出隐式视觉思维链框架，将结构规划与外观渲染解耦，通过训练时草图监督提升文本到图像生成的结构遵循能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为多模态大模型在复杂空间关系、属性绑定等结构感知任务上提供了一种无需推理时额外解码的隐式推理方案。

items.social_original_text:
Good post on the dynamics of AI pricing right now. We’re basically going to see a barbell dynamic on pricing between high cost frontier models and cheap but good open or closed weights models.

Then the question is how do you maximize efficiency from the frontier models, and get better quality and performance of the cheaper models. That’s where the applied AI layer comes in.

The applied layer can route to the best model at any time given the workload at hand, as well as mitigate either high token costs or worse performance. The closer you are to the underlying workflow, the better you can tune the use of models for a given business process.

That’s all about understanding the workflows, domain specific FDEs, evals by customer or process, getting data setup well for agents, and more. Overall good for applied AI.
